timeline.summary: Arkade Developers received a CGST order on April 30, 2026, demanding ₹1.15 crore plus a ₹11.46 lakh penalty for historical ITC disallowances.
Arkade Developers filed its final monitoring agency report for the quarter ended March 31, 2026
Arkade Developers acquired cluster redevelopment rights for 9 societies in Kandivali East with projected GDV of ~₹1,100 Cr.
Arkade Developers released its Q4 & FY26 investor presentation highlighting ₹901 Cr pre-sales and details on the ₹3,500 Cr GDV Filmistan project.
Amit Mangilal Jain, Chairman & Managing Director, hosted an analysts/institutional investor meet on May 27, 2026, discussing audited financial results for Q4FY26 and FY26.
Arkade Developers held its Q4FY26 concall, guiding for 20-25% revenue growth and 27-28% EBITDA margins.
Q1FY27 results: Pre-sales up 9% YoY to ₹155 Cr; EBITDA margin 18.9%; net debt ₹5 Cr; FY27 launch pipeline ₹3,000 Cr
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹144.65 Cr (-45.1% YoY), net profit ₹24.81 Cr (-45.8% YoY).
